title.en: The head of state who does not give the antidote

subtitle.zh-TW: 兩人都握有解藥而沒給，保鑣是死因，與市長毫無職責關係的國家元首不是。
subtitle.en: Both hold an antidote and neither gives it, yet the bodyguard's omission is a cause and that of a head of state with no duty to the mayor is not.

story.zh-TW: 考慮市長中毒的情境。殺手在市長喝的咖啡裡下毒。保鑣帶著可以中和毒性的解藥，沒有給市長服用。一位與市長毫無職責關係的國家元首也帶著同樣的解藥，同樣沒有給。市長死亡。假如保鑣或元首任一人給了解藥，市長就不會死。
story.en: Consider a poisoned mayor again. An assassin puts poison in the mayor's coffee. The bodyguard carries an antidote that would neutralise it and does not give it to the mayor; a head of state who has no duty toward the mayor also carries such an antidote and does not give it either. The mayor dies. Had the bodyguard or the head of state given the antidote, the mayor would not have died.

zh-TW.sentence: 殺手在市長喝的咖啡裡下毒。
保鑣帶著可以中和毒性的解藥，沒有給市長服用。
一位與市長毫無職責關係的國家元首也帶著同樣的解藥，同樣沒有給。

en.sentence: An assassin puts poison in the mayor's coffee.
The bodyguard carries an antidote that would neutralise it and does not give it to the mayor;
a head of state who has no duty toward the mayor also carries such an antidote and does not give it either.

text.zh-TW: 元首沒有保護市長的職責，沒給解藥是意料中的事，不算死因。
text.en: The head of state has no duty to protect the mayor; his not giving the antidote is what one would expect and is not counted a cause.

explanation.zh-TW: 模型是王一奇與王鵬翔 (2021) 的 Om+。A = 1 表示殺手下毒，B = 1 表示保鑣沒給解藥，C = 1 表示元首給解藥，D = A·B·¬C。保鑣有護主職責，沒給是偏差。元首沒有職責，沒給合乎常態（normality），所以 C 的預設值（default）是 0。原文以中國國家主席為例，此處改稱國家元首。
explanation.en: The model is Om+ of Wang and Wang (2021), the 'bodyguard plus chairman' case: A = 1 is the assassin poisoning the coffee, B = 1 is the bodyguard withholding the antidote (the deviant value), C = 1 is the head of state giving the antidote (actually 0), and D = A·B·¬C. The source uses the Chairman of China as its example; a generic head of state is used here. The bodyguard has a duty to protect, so once the poison is in, withholding is the deviant value; the head of state has no such duty, so not giving is the default and giving would be the surprise (C is normally 0). Only the network from B to D is self-contained, so only the bodyguard's omission is a paradigmatic cause. The engine agrees: but-for and the modified HP definition count C = 0 as a cause (over-generation), and only the normality-based definition excludes it, because the world in which C = 1 is not at least as normal as the actual one (it deviates in C, the actual world in D).

sources.citation: Wang, P.-H., & Wang, L. (2021). Parasitic counterfactual dependence and paradigmatic causation [Jisheng de fanshishi yilai yu dianxing yinguo guanxi; in Chinese]. Journal of Philosophy, National Chengchi University, 45, 39–90.

note.zh-TW: p.75 給出 Om+ 的方程式（澆花版 D = A·B·¬C）。p.76 給出主席案例，說明保鑣加主席的 Om+ 與 C 的意義。p.77 討論 A 與 D 的依賴是否寄生。
note.en: P. 75 gives the equations of Om+ (the watering version, D = A·B·¬C); p. 76 gives the Chairman case (omission) and explains Om+ for the bodyguard plus Chairman; p. 77 discusses whether the dependence of D on A is parasitic.
